mapper.sql: select user_id, student_no, coach_no, campus, college, major_name, class_name, id_no, emergency_contact, emergency_phone, bio, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sp_user_profile_ext
mapper.insert: insert into sp_user_profile_ext ( user_id, student_no, coach_no, campus, college, major_name, class_name, id_no, emergency_contact, emergency_phone, bio, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{studentNo}, #{coachNo}, #{campus}, #{college}, #{majorName}, #{className}, #{idNo}, #{emergencyContact}, #{emergencyPhone}, #{bio}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate() )
